description: Address 6 issues found during semantic review: (1) Invoices page reads old key data.invoices, (2) Subscriptions page reads old key data.subscriptions, (3) Products search endpoint missing escapeLike, (4) Subscriptions total count ignores status filter, (5) deal-related-panel JSDoc comment stale, (6) Invoice unique-violation detection should use error code 23505 instead of message.includes('unique').
steps: Fix app/tenant/invoices/page.tsx: change data.invoices to data.data
Fix app/tenant/subscriptions/page.tsx: change data.subscriptions to data.data
Fix app/api/tenant/products/route.ts: import and use escapeLike on the q parameter
Fix app/api/tenant/subscriptions/route.ts: use and(...conditions) for total count query
Fix components/tenant/deal-related-panel.tsx: update stale JSDoc comment
Fix app/api/tenant/invoices/route.ts and app/api/tenant/quotes/[id]/convert-to-invoice/route.ts: check (err as any).code === '23505' instead of message.includes('unique')
acceptance_criteria: Frontend pages read data.data instead of old keys
Products search uses escapeLike on user input
Subscriptions total count respects status filter
Unique violation detection uses PostgreSQL error code
